Name: Seasonal Hallway Wallpaper
Author: Khyraen
Description:
[size=2][b]Just in time for the holidays! 

8 seasonal wallpapers MADE for your empty hallway walls[/b] [/size][size=1](& hopefully more coming)[/size]

Ever wondered why you can't hang anything in the hallway of your farmhouse? Maybe you've felt your upgraded cabin needs more holiday spirit? Perhaps you are a minimalist & would love to slap on some wallpaper & actually feel comfortable entertaining at your place. This is the mod you've been looking for!

We have created a collection of seasonal hallway wallpapers that can be ADDED to your game [b]based on StarAmy's Double Wide Hallway Wallpapers[/b]. 

Right now the collection is small because I got distracted making wallpapers for the rooms based on the images I created here & just haven't come back to this project yet. (I still have a blanket I never finished sewing that I started for my daughter who is 33.)

[size=5]Mod Requirements[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ (& it's requirements) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12510]Custom Wallpaper Framework[/url]﻿.


[size=2][b]Mod Updates[/b][/size]

[b][size=1]0.1.1 Update | Oct 29, 2023[/size][/b]

* Improved Spring Candles wallpaper to make the sconce appear more silver.
* Added a Nexus update key

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

[size=2]Some of the graphics in this mod were made by editing graphics created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/142361808]StarAmy[/url] in her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17900?tab=files]Double Wide Hallway Wallpapers[/url] & we are thankful to her for her beautiful mods, her permission to edit those graphics & her encouragement to upload this mod. Please check out all her mods. [/size]

This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12510]Custom Wallpaper Framework[/url] to create wallpapers that are wider & therefore can have even more detailed & creative designs. That mod is required. We are thankful for this wonderful mod.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. We are grateful for this mod that enables so much of the SDV modding experience.
